### gasStorage2d

This example shows a liquid (water) entering inside a porous media filled with gas (compressed hydrogen at 100 bar) and replacing the gas, only to a certain extent as some of the gas remains trapped in the porous domain, which gives the effective porosity for such removal of stored gas processes.
To run this example, download the appropriate vti file with

```{.bash}
curl https://openlb.net/data/gas_storage/gasStorage2d.vti -o storage.vti
./gasStorage2d storage.vti "Tiff Scalars"
```
